summary: John's 3rd cousin 8x removed (Bull → Daniel → Daniel 2d → Caleb → Caleb II); 1798 mill partner.
bio:
Built a house in Hauppauge in 1790, reported to have stood at Veterans Highway and Old Willets Path, where the Suffolk County Police Fourth Precinct is today; moved to Commack in 1819; gave the Hauppauge house to daughter Sarah when she married Maj. Ebenezer Smith.

His wife Elizabeth, daughter of Aaron Smith 2d, was presumably a granddaughter of Aaron Smith (son of Job 1st), which would make his children John's cousins through Job Smith as well; Aaron 2d's parentage was not checked.
